svg.title: MCHOSE Hub Rust
svg.desc: Open-source native MCHOSE Hub. Official MCHOSE and Rust logos beside the project name; a white A7 mouse and MagDock on the right. Reverse engineered, MIT, Windows and Linux.
svg.metadata: Design direction: native device utility, ENERGY 1 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 1. Near-black surfaces and the restrained blue accent match the native application palette. Left-aligned text and generous spacing separate the project identity from the actual device renders. Noto Sans supplies clear system-style typography without decorative tracking or a monospace treatment. Product renders and official unmodified logos identify the supported hardware and implementation language. No interactive controls, simulated app screenshots, generated brand artwork, statistics or endorsement claims. Rust logo source: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-artwork, CC BY 4.0. Device and MCHOSE logo source records: assets/provenance.json.
